memoryRule: pressure is stored while held without geometry change; release turns elapsed duration into force that changes a remote receiver's depth/aperture/extrusion, loosens an echo, and opens a counterform; later casts inherit the altered rack
interactionRule: press and hold one block, release to cast remotely; Arrow keys choose a source; Enter, Space, and the cast control use deterministic pressure; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: browser-native double register, SVG negative-space plate, and Canvas cadence score -> WebGL perspective rack of letter molds
compositionRupture: asymmetrical registers, one folded plane, and three temporal columns -> irregular depth-staggered casting object with apertures and extrusion
encounterRupture: witness and leave, load two wells, and tap three beats -> press, hold, and release a source into a remote production event
temporalRupture: remote departure, negative-space fold, and cadence memory -> elapsed pressure becomes a spatially displaced manufacturing memory
mediumRupture: semantic DOM text, inline SVG, and p5.js Canvas 2D -> raw WebGL textured letter slabs with 3D depth
renderer: deterministic raw WebGL pressure casting rack
changedRule: A held source stores pressure without moving. Release uses elapsed pressure to produce a remote receiver through actual depth, aperture, and extrusion, while an echo loosens and a counterform opens; the source remains exact.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is an irregular three-dimensional rack of twelve letter molds. A release changes a remote block's depth and opening, a second block's confidence, and a third counterform; four casts persist and later casts inherit the altered mold field.
falsifier: Delete if holding deforms geometry, if the source is the answer, if depth/aperture/extrusion are cosmetic, if the rack reads as a flat grid or type specimen, if later casts reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v035 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish pressure casting from a decorative 3D word wall, or if release does not produce a visibly remote material consequence.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
